This isn't really ready for review yet. I need to make the update pinned files async to return the pinned files and create a file notifier for the pinned files folder to use it in sidebar and the widget.

issue_context.title: Bug: Pinned items don't show when Files is set to stay open in the background
issue_context.body:
> [!Important]
> Current work around is to turn off `Files settings > Advanced > Leave app running in the background` then close and reopen Files. If the issue still happens try the instructions [here](https://answers.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/forum/all/windows-11-quick-access-folders-gone-and-pin-to/49b3f66a-062f-43e6-8417-728e2a42c896) and restart your computer.

### Description

There has been 1 report on GitHub and 2 in Discord of this issue. All of them relating to the start with Windows option and closing and reopening Files fixes the issue.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Enable Files settings > Advanced > Open Files on Windows Startup
2. Enable Files settings > Advanced > Leave app running in the background when the window is closed
3. Restart Windows
4. Open Files
5. See pinned items are missing

### Requirements

- Load pins items when Files is opened on Windows Startup

### Files Version

3.4.1.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22631.3593

### Log File

[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/15337244/debug.log)
